dedupe_keys.name: awesome cge scenarios and modelling outputs

description: The AWESOME project deposits a spreadsheet of computable-general-equilibrium scenario shocks and outputs for alternative water supply in the Mediterranean region. Its Zenodo description says the analysis split the GTAP water sector into natural, desalinated and treated-water activities, then tested effects on food security under climate pressure. The public XLSX file is about 242 KB and Zenodo states CC BY 4.0. Scenario outputs could inform economic assumptions in simulations of desalination, wastewater reuse or cross-sector infrastructure choices. This is a published scenario workbook, not an executable GTAP model or a substitute for the licensed GTAP10A input database. The page does not give a sheet-by-sheet variable dictionary, country coverage or an independent validation. Those details and any upstream GTAP rights require separate checks before reproducing the analysis. Round one rejected the item as a single-study result, but a documented spreadsheet with distinct water-supply scenarios is reusable under the current rule. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this workbook. Its cells were not downloaded or recalculated.
name: AWESOME CGE scenarios and modelling outputs
